Field.name: ArticleSerialNumber
Field.description: A mandatory field if the OAN is not used. It provides the identification number of an item of property.

Field.name: OwnerAppliedNumber
Field.description: A unique identification number or inscription which is permanently stamped, etched, engraved or welded on an item of property by its owner, (e.g., drivers license or social security number). OAN is mandatory for entry if the SER is not available on the property. NOTE: Pawn/Buy transactions do not require SER or OAN if CAT is A or N.

Field.name: CancellationDate
Field.description: The date a record is canceled. Mandatory for Cancel. Must be equal to or greater than DOT and equal to or less than current date. Code as YYYYMMDD.

Field.name: FileControlNumber
Field.description: A computer generated number assigned and forwarded to the entering agency by the CJIS computer to each accepted record. The FCN is mandatory for Modify, Locate, Cancel, and Clear transactions.

Field.name: OriginatingAgencyCaseNumber
Field.description: The master case file number. A mandatory field for all update transactions. For Pawn or Buy entries use the Loan/Buy number recorded on the Pawnbroker/Secondhand Dealer Report for the OCA. Interfield Dependency: OCA position 1-7 cannot be the same as the ORI positions 1-7.

Field.name: PropertyRecordRemovalReason
Field.description: Statistical field to collect Benefits Data. This information is passed to NCIC and not retained in the APS record. For APS the RPP code shall be one of the following: HIT LOCAL YYYYMMDD HIT STATE YYYYMMDD HIT NCIC YYYYMMDD OTHER MEANS PREVIOUSLY LOCATED PREVIOUSLY RECOVERED CASE DROPPED NOT STOLEN Interfield Dependency: The fields NPA, NPF, VNP, VOR, and VRC, cannot be used if RPP is blank. The codes CASE DROPPED and NOT STOLEN can only be used in cancel transactions.

Field.name: ClearDate
Field.description: The date the record is cleared. Mandatory for Clear. Must be equal to or greater than DOT and equal to or less than current date. Code as YYYYMMDD.

Field.name: ContrabandRecoveredValue
Field.description: Statistical field to collect Benefits Data. Fair market value (in whole dollars) of the article when it was recovered. No special characters. Interfield Dependency: Shall be 0 (zero) or blank when RPP is OTHER MEANS or PREVIOUSLY RECOVERED.

Field.name: FileControlNumber

Field.name: NumberMissingPersonsFound
Field.description: Statistical field to collect Benefits Data. Interfield Dependency: SHALL be 0 (zero) or blank when RPP is OTHER MEANS or PREVIOUSLY RECOVERED. User note: (nnn represents number) Count all missing persons found as a result of a record being located or cleared. Field.name: NumberPersonsApprehended
Field.description: Statistical field to collect Benefits Data. Count of person(s) arrested as a result of recovering the stolen article in the record being located. Interfield Dependency: SHALL be 0 (zero) or blank when RPP is OTHER MEANS or PREVIOUSLY RECOVERED.

Field.name: OriginatingAgencyCaseNumber
